articles.title: Even Birds Get Jet Lag
articles.summary: Manx shearwaters racing home across the Atlantic veer slightly off course, apparently because their inner clocks fall out of sync with the sun.

articles.title: Zverev Reaches the Top of Men's Tennis
articles.summary: Alexander Zverev will become world No. 1 on Monday after his Vienna win, capping a year with two Grand Slam titles and 64 wins from 80 matches.

articles.title: A New Short Film Joins My Chemical Romance's World
articles.summary: Lauren Tsai's Prelude to The End continues Astrid's story with voices from Billie Eilish and Phoebe Bridgers, set to The Black Parade's opening song.
